component_findings.dependency_metadata: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-1--typescript): npmjs.com listed Jest's latest version (30.5.2) as published a day before the snapshot, and pkgpulse's health-score comparison rated Jest 86/100 for combined maintenance, quality, security and popularity signals.
component_findings.distribution_artifacts: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-1--typescript): Sampled flagship packages across validation, testing, type-definitions, and core tooling show release activity within the last 1-7 days to 3 months, with independent third-party health scorers (Snyk, Socket.dev, PkgPulse) classifying maintenance as 'Sustainable' or 'Healthy'/'very good'. One sampled flagship (Express core framework) showed a materially slower 9-month release gap, which is reflected as a partial deduction since package_ecosystem_activity_maintenance must account for variance, not only the most-active samples. The registry-wide caveat that raw package counts include abandoned packages was also treated as a moderating factor rather than a straightforward positive.

component_findings.application_testing: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-1--typescript): All 7 predeclared domains have a mature, high-download, actively-shipping flagship library with either native TypeScript-first design (Zod) or first-class/official TypeScript type support (Express, React, Jest, Redux Toolkit), plus a dedicated large-scale community safety net (DefinitelyTyped, 8,000+ typed packages) for anything not natively typed. Coverage is judged near-complete but not scored 100 because a small residual of niche/enterprise domains still rely on community (not maintainer-shipped) types of variable quality, per DefinitelyTyped's own scope note that untyped packages are common in the broader npm ecosystem.
component_findings.data_numerical: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-1--typescript): Redux Toolkit is reported as remaining the standard for large-scale React applications requiring strict unidirectional data flow, with approximately 9 million weekly downloads, alongside actively growing alternatives (Zustand ~7M monthly, Jotai, Recoil) in the same category.
component_findings.ml_ai: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-1--typescript): The public npm registry replication endpoint reported about 4.04 million registry documents in mid-2026, and npm is described as remaining one of the most widely used software package registries, serving billions of downloads on a regular basis.
